text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building reliable web applications and backend systems. I’d be glad to help with your legal document drafting AI assistant backend and move quickly on the implementation so it integrates smoothly with your existing front end.

My experience covers JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and the full stack. For a project like this, I’d focus on building a clean backend architecture for AI-assisted document drafting, user workflows, and the API layer needed to connect the front end to the AI functionality in a dependable way.

A recent project that’s relevant is **Charity admin modernisation**, where I upgraded a Django 1.11 donor system to Django 4.1 and rebuilt the donation entry screens with HTMX. One result was that donation entry time went down 45%, while preserving zero data loss across 180k donor records. That project required careful backend work, data integrity, and a smooth user workflow.

I also worked on **Streaming chat widget**, where I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. One result was first token on screen in about 600 ms, supporting 30k chats a month. That experience is directly relevant to AI integration, streaming responses, and creating a responsive assistant experience.

For your project, I would aim to:
- implement the backend logic for legal document drafting workflows
- connect the AI assistant to the existing front end through a stable API
- support document selection, customization, and generation flows
- keep the system simple, maintainable, and quick to deliver

I understand the need for a fast turnaround and can work efficiently to deliver within your 10-day timeline. I’d be happy to discuss the backend structure and the best way to integrate the AI assistant into your current product.
